results.description:
A knight torn between blood and oath must choose which king is worth dying for.

Scotland, 1306. Orphaned and raised by an English-sworn foster father, Thomas Randolph knows only duty to his adopted kin. Then Robert the Bruce takes the throne. He takes a vow as a Scottish knight, rides at the Bruce's side, and stakes his future on a king who fights to free a nation. At Methven, under a rush of English steel, Thomas shields his king, falls in the heat of battle, and faces execution—until his foster father drags him back from death and binds him to march in enemy colors against his own land.

What follows is a hard test of honor and survival. Thomas serves beneath a banner he cannot claim, fighting through desperate Highland ambushes and battles. Memories of brotherhood press on him; Bruce's purpose beats in his chest.

Fans of tight, fast-paced historical fiction, sharp moral stakes, and the growth of a man from youth to legend will love Noble Traitor, where the price of freedom marks the soul—and faith may cost all he has left. Don't wait. Buy now.
